title: The Dawn Era Triceratops - Jurassic Park_World
description: Triceratops skin from Jurassic Park and World inspired
body:
This Resource Pack change Triceratops texture to 3 skins inspired from Jurassic Park and World franchise:

-male: it has a bluish-gray with gray belly, inspirated from Jurassic Park 1 movie

-female: it has a greenish color with brownish belly, inspirated from Jurassic World Fallen Kingdom movie

-baby: it has brownish color overall, inspirated from Jurassic World Fallen Kingdom movie

Credits:

I thank X1sh and their team for creating The Dawn Era

Also, I thank Steveguy2025 for giving me inspiration through their creation, The Dawn Era Tyrannosaurus Rex (Jurassic Park Styled)
